## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

Surveyed before implementation; the seam map:

| AC leg | Found | Missing |
|---|---|---|
| adapter declaration | `benchmark_adapter` trait ops (`discover`/`materialize`/`expose`/`collect_submission`/`grade`/`export`/`parity`) | `adapter_declaration/1` record + default `declare()`; declared-facts rule; `HostingSurface`/`ExportFormat` closed sums; `HostingSurfaceUnsupported`/`ExportFormatUnsupported`/`GranularityRefused` |
| `parity = none` | `parity()` returning a report or `ParityUnavailable` | `parity_ref` as a contract member; `none` ⇒ product-only admission (`admits_granularity`), never silent scope-down |
| stratum B | corpus declared strata A/C/D/E; `SuiteValidityRecord` shape landed | `suite.swe_fresh` fixtures; `l2_check` (epoch-seeded + dispatch ref) load-time gate; flawed-task marking with retirement reasons/audit refs/split assignments |
| stratum G | — | `suite.harbor_index` smoke fixtures; `parity = none`, native-only hosting |
| foreign export/import | `hh-results` loss-report machinery; `hh-bundle` interchange codecs | `hh-bench::foreign` — `harbor_trial_dir` lossy export + Harness-Bench `import_result` under `unverified` provenance, `LoweringLossReport` naming every drop |
| M12 rollup | `cost_view` per-run fold; `control.subagent.*` rows | `cost_view_run_tree` — children exactly once under parent `subagent` scope; malformed trees refused |
| M18 ingestion | hosted `lift_event` single-row lift | `lift_event_rows` dual classification — `participant_reported` vs `reconstructed_from_native_log` |
| interchange loss | `interchange_trajectory` bundle export | `unit_conversion` loss entries over `cost_view` fields |
| hosted bundles / lineage | `traces.audit_tree_head` (S4.14b); bundle claims | hosted-participant version + drift claims; lineage export with audit head |
| `rotate`/`migrate_id` e2e | `RotationPlan`/`BridgeRecord`/`IdMigration` + rotation checkpoint (S4.14b) | chained-run rotation e2e (AC-R-2.12.1-6); cross-run anchor re-verification under the claim's identity profile |
| judge oracles | `OracleDeclaration`/`run_oracle`; metric catalogue | `admit_judge` (calibration + independence), `emit_judged` (judged beside, never in, deterministic), `execution_alignment_failure_rate{,_judged}` catalogue families |
| `capability_vector` | hosted rows carry `manifest.extra` | strict parse — verbatim projection, typed `n/a` for absent/unsupported, typed refusal on unknown/malformed |
| env profiles | `stage3_fault_profiles`/`stage3_perturbation_profiles` | launch-time validation + manifest stamping; unknown/non-string/disagreeing-level refusals |

## Build log

- **hh-bench** (`src/adapter.rs`, `adapters.rs`, `benchset.rs`,
  `foreign.rs` (new), `bin/hh_bench_adapter.rs`, `lib.rs`):
  `AdapterDeclaration` — the `adapter_declaration/1` record —
  built by the default `declare()` from each adapter's
  declared facts (`decl_facts()` keyed by adapter id);
  `HostingSurface` (`native_participant`/`container_installed`/
  `session_abi`) and `ExportFormat` (`adapter_export`/
  `harbor_trial_dir`) closed sums; `admits_surface`,
  `admits_export_format`, `admits_granularity` —
  `parity = none` admits `product` only (I-5, ADR-0308 D2).
  Corpus → six strata: `benchset.json` declares
  `a`/`b`/`c`/`d`/`e`/`g`; `SuiteManifest::validate()` runs
  `SuiteValidityRecord::l2_check` (epoch-seeded + non-empty
  `dispatch_ref`) — B contributes headline rows only once its
  validity record exists; flawed tasks are marked
  (retired-for-headline + reasons + audit refs + split
  assignments/hashes), never dropped (ADR-0308 D3).
  `foreign.rs`: `export(format)` — `adapter_export` lossless,
  `harbor_trial_dir` lossy with `LoweringLossReport`/`LossEntry`
  per dropped member; `import_result` lifts Harness-Bench
  results under `unverified` provenance and reports members
  with no foreign slot (ADR-0308 D4). The adapter binary
  serves `declare` and the export ops out-of-process;
  participant callers stay refused instrument-plane ops.
- **hh-eval** (`src/judge.rs` (new), `catalogue.rs`,
  `lib.rs`): `admit_judge` gates on `CalibrationStatus` +
  `CriticUse` — beneficiary-context/snapshot sharing,
  declared-family overclaim, independence minimums, and
  model-claim-only evidence refuse; `emit_judged` emits into
  the `*_judged` family beside the deterministic metric —
  calibrated judges may gate, uncalibrated emit
  `exploratory` only; `execution_alignment_failure_rate{,_judged}`
  are distinct catalogue families (ADR-0308 D5).
- **hh-analysis** (`src/project.rs`): `capability_vector`
  from `manifest.extra` — verbatim projection, supported →
  admit, absent/unsupported → typed `n/a{reason}`, unknown
  spelling/malformed member → typed `AnalysisError`
  (ADR-0308 D6).
- **hh-experiment** (`src/engine.rs`): env fault/perturbation
  profile overrides validated at launch (unknown id /
  non-string member / disagreeing levels refuse) and stamped
  onto the run manifest.
- **hh-ledger** (`tests/s4_15.rs`):
  `ac_r_2_12_1_6_rotate_corpus_over_chained_runs` — rotation
  checkpoint + `migrate_id` over a chained run corpus;
  cross-run anchor re-verification under the claim's identity
  profile (the WIP fix).
- **hh-bundle** (`tests/s4_15.rs`): hosted-participant bundle
  claims (participant version + drift data), lineage export
  with audit head, `interchange_trajectory` cost-view
  lowering declaring `unit_conversion` losses.
- **hh-telemetry** (`src/views.rs`): `cost_view_run_tree` —
  M12 rollup, children exactly once under `subagent`;
  malformed trees refuse `CostTreeError`.
- **hh-hosting** (`src/proj.rs`): `lift_event_rows` — M18
  ingestion classifying `participant_reported` vs
  `reconstructed_from_native_log`.
- **hh-fleet / hh-embed**: hosted/fleet participation support
  over the same surfaces.
- **Tests:** `hh-bench/tests/s4_15.rs` (10),
  `hh-eval/tests/s4_15.rs` (12), `hh-analysis/tests/s4_15.rs`
  (5), `hh-experiment/tests/engine.rs` (+5),
  `hh-bundle/tests/s4_15.rs` (3), `hh-ledger/tests/s4_15.rs`
  (1); run-tree/M18 legs in `hh-telemetry/tests/acceptance.rs`
  and `hh-hosting/tests/hosting.rs`.
- **ADR-0308** records the six rulings: declared-facts
  `AdapterDeclaration` + default `declare()`; `parity = none`
  ⇒ product-only; `l2_check` as the load-time headline gate;
  foreign interchange as explicit lowering with loss reports;
  judge admission/emission separation; strict
  `capability_vector` handling.

## Fix found by verification

- `hh-monitor` s3_11a `ac_r_2_1_5_11_hosted_rows_are_class_
  gated` failed on the first workspace run — the new
  `execution_alignment_failure_rate` catalogue row escaped
  the hosted/native class gate (`native-only row`). Fixed by
  classifying the family correctly; the re-run is all-green.

## Notes / deviations

- **Declarations are facts, not inference** (ADR-0308 D1):
  `FixtureAdapter::decl_facts()` is the single fact table —
  a fixture-derived declaration would make the harness's
  check circular (CC2/CC3).
- **`identity.rs` carries literal NUL separators** inside
  `format!` strings (pre-existing, lands as `Bin` in `git
  diff`) — unchanged semantics; noted so reviewers don't
  misread the binary-marker diff.
- **Deferrals** — `DF-S1.14-3` closed (M12 rollup + M18
  ingestion + interchange loss all executable);
  `DF-S1.14-2` progress note (run-tree rollup cell landed;
  convention-shaped sinks, hosted `n/a` sweep, per-config
  catalogue distributions remain). No new rows opened.
